tasks.short: Audition and select performers for musical presentations.

steps.what: Set musical requirements and audition criteria for the presentation
Audition performers and hear their musical response to direction
Select performers considering musical quality, ensemble balance and artistic fit
Write and approve the final selection record and performer notification text
Commit the approved performer selection record
Send the approved selection notification to the corresponding performer

tasks.design: Keep actual auditions, artistic selection and selection-record writing human. Retain the existing {OTHER} selection record save and separate performer notice send. After splitting both actions, native forms and existing messaging add no further saving or configuration.
tasks.previous_blocker: Ensemble fit depends on listening, interpretation and the performer's response to direction.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record and message actions can route an explicitly decided and fully written selection result.
tasks.still_hard: Artistry, blend and responsiveness require the director's ear and judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Hear musical potential and choose the combination that serves the presentation.
tasks.altitude: A small administrative gain after selection, without shortening auditions.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native project records and message routing can handle approved selection outcomes without assessing performers.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for the director's own audition and selection episode; performer and panel time are excluded. Verify actual separate save/send effort before adoption; existing automated actions earn no saving.

s4 director enters production_id, performer_id, role, decision, rationale and final_message. Capture, wording and fairness review remain fully counted; no pre-existing structured audition scores are assumed.

a1 binds the finished private selection record and destination; a2 binds each actual final message and its intended performer after s4. Edits invalidate the relevant approval. A selection notification does not issue a contract or promise unapproved terms.
Native record and mail-draft actions are evaluated first. Missing performer identity or contact returns to manual handling; no automatic candidate matching or ranking is introduced.
research_questions: Can each notification be traced to the approved final selection without disclosing another performer's assessment?

incremental.description: Check selection-record access and performer-message routing

approvals.approved_version: s4 final selection record and restricted destination
s4 final individual notification and performer recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Actual auditions, selection, writing and existing save and send retain full effort; no new upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan rehearsals and performances, arranging venues, accompanists and instrumentalists.

steps.what: Confirm and record venue, accompanist and instrumentalist availability and booking constraints
Decide rehearsal priorities, musical groupings and adequate preparation time
Find conflict-free rehearsal and performance schedules satisfying explicit constraints
Negotiate unresolved clashes and provisional venue or musician arrangements
Check and approve the complete schedule, booking messages and participant notices
Send the approved venue booking confirmation
Send approved accompanist and instrumentalist booking confirmations
Commit the approved schedule to the production calendar
Send the approved rehearsal and performance notices to participants

tasks.design: Use native {CALENDAR} availability tools first; if they cannot express section, venue and duration constraints, use a small deterministic scheduler with explicit {SPREADSHEET} inputs. Keep availability capture, musical priorities, negotiation and final package checking human. Venue confirmations, musician confirmations, calendar commit and participant notices are separate gated actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Availability alone does not encode what the ensemble must rehearse together or the venue's practical constraints.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit constraints can be checked deterministically once the director has confirmed and entered them.
tasks.still_hard: Negotiating exceptions and choosing rehearsal priorities remain musical and interpersonal work.
tasks.human_edge: Know when a technically feasible schedule leaves too little preparation or damages a working relationship.
tasks.altitude: Reduce conflict searching and approved schedule distribution without transferring availability capture to musicians.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit resource and duration constraints permit deterministic schedule generation; this does not establish current manual scheduling effort.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for director work on a scheduling cycle. Existing calendar tools earn no new saving, and no musician or venue labour is claimed as displaced.

Venue and musician contacts produce availability replies; s1 director checks and enters contact_id, resource_id, free_window, timezone, venue_capacity, equipment and agreed_hold. s2 supplies required_sections, duration, rest_gap and sequence. All interpretation/capture remains fully counted; missing availability is resolved manually.

s3 returns explicit conflicts rather than assuming absent constraints. s4 remains provisional and does not commit bookings; s5 creates and checks the actual final schedule, messages, fee/terms references and recipients within existing authority.

a1/a2 bind each final booking message and recipient, a3 the final calendar rows, and a4 the final notices and participant list after s5. Any change revokes affected approvals. This path assumes existing agreed holds permit confirmation; new contract negotiations remain human and receive no automated credit.
A declined hold or conflicting reply returns to s4/s5 for a new approved package, not automatic rescheduling. Calendar commit sends no implicit invites; s9 represents that separate send.
research_questions: Can native calendar tools satisfy the ensemble-specific constraints before a custom scheduler is justified?

incremental.description: Maintain scheduling constraints and check calendar/message mappings

approvals.approved_version: s5 final venue confirmation, terms and recipient
s5 final individual musician confirmations and recipients
s5 final schedule rows and calendar destination
s5 final participant notices and recipient list

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional scheduling calculation saves 20 points minus two upkeep = 18; partial eligible scheduling gives eight. Availability capture, negotiations, actual schedule checking, three sends and calendar commit retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write musical scores suited to instrumental and vocal capabilities.

steps.what: Compose the musical material, form and intended expressive character
Enter the composer's chosen notes in music notation software
Write and refine orchestration, voicing, phrasing and playable musical textures
Generate correctly transposed parts and score layouts in notation software
outputs: candidate full score and performance parts

steps.what: Hear, read and approve the final score and every performance part
inputs: candidate full score and performance parts

steps.what: Save the approved final score package to the composition archive
Send the approved score and parts to the authorised ensemble contact

tasks.design: Keep musical invention and orchestration with the composer. Configure native MIDI step entry or real-time input in {OTHER}, music notation software, to capture the composer's chosen notes; use native part extraction and transposition. Full listening and part review precede separate approved archive and delivery actions. No generative model composes the work.
tasks.previous_blocker: A playable, expressive score requires musical choices beyond entering pitches and generating part files.
tasks.enabler_now: Native notation tools can capture performed notes and derive exact parts from an explicitly written score.
tasks.still_hard: Form, musical meaning, balance, idiomatic writing and effective phrasing remain compositional work.
tasks.human_edge: Hear what the music should express and write for the actual performers' capabilities.
tasks.altitude: Reduce note-entry and part-production effort while retaining artistic decisions.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: notation software can accept MIDI input, transpose written material and generate linked performance parts; exact product support needs confirmation.

assumptions: Provisional shares concern an original score currently requiring hands-on note entry and part preparation. Existing linked-part generation or MIDI use earns no new benefit. Creative composition and orchestration retain full time.

s2 composer produces the MIDI input directly from the chosen sketch. Playing, entering rhythm, quantisation correction and checking are included in its retained 13 hours; there is no free recording or transcription source. Unsuitable passages use direct manual note entry.

s3 composer supplies part_id, instrument, written_pitch_mapping, staff_assignment and range limits while orchestrating; all capture stays in s3. Native software derives parts from those mappings; missing mappings block export until manually resolved.

s5 retains full score listening/reading and each part's clefs, transposition, page turns and playability check. a1 binds final package hashes and archive; a2 binds the same final files and authorised recipient after review. Edits revoke approvals.
The 65% entry estimate must be tested on this composer's actual method. No unobserved creative time or software playback runtime is counted as saved labour.
research_questions: Does MIDI entry plus rhythm correction save hands-on time for this composer's actual notation style?

incremental.description: Maintain notation templates, input settings and delivery mappings

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete final score/part hashes and archive destination
s5 final score/part package and ensemble recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional notation entry and native part layout yield 12 points minus one upkeep = 11; partial eligible entry gives 2.5. Composition, final musical checks, archiving and sending retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Position musicians to balance instrumental or vocal sections.

steps.what: Listen to section balance from relevant positions in the actual space
Position members within groups to improve instrumental or vocal balance
Hear the trial balance and agree the final member positions
Record and check the final positions on the existing stage-layout template
Save the checked final ensemble layout
Share the approved final layout with the internal stage team

tasks.design: Retain listening, physical positioning instructions and listening again. Split the final layout write, save and internal share from that in-person work. Use the existing {DOCS} stage-layout template and native link sharing; no further saving is established for a small layout updated directly in that template.
tasks.previous_blocker: Balance depends on the actual musicians, repertoire and acoustics of the space.
tasks.enabler_now: No new mechanism is established beyond the existing native layout template.
tasks.still_hard: A seating geometry alone does not tell the director how the ensemble actually sounds.
tasks.human_edge: Hear blend and projection and adjust people sensitively while preserving musical communication.
tasks.altitude: No demonstrated saving after separating the layout record and share.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: listening to actual balance and directing positions remain musical judgement; native layout templates can already support the brief record.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for director work in a rehearsal that retains a simple final layout. The musicians' own playing and moving effort is not claimed as director savings.

s4 director captures member_or_section, position, row and orientation on the existing native template, then checks the actual final diagram. No acoustic measurements, tracking system or structured seating feed is assumed.

The template, native save and link-share options are considered explicitly. For a single short direct update, no duplicate drawing, retyping or repeat distribution baseline is invented. If such duplication is observed, reassess that step.
a1 binds the final layout and destination; a2 binds the final link and internal stage recipients after s4. All record/share steps retain full time and introduce no new system upkeep.
unknowns: Existing stage template and sharing route
research_questions: Is there any actual repeated layout entry beyond the direct template update represented here?

incremental.description: No new software; keep the existing stage template and share route

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final ensemble layout and destination
s4 checked final layout link and internal recipients

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All 100 director units remain, including 8 layout-writing, 1 save and 1 share units. No new labour or unverified saving is introduced.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Preserve musical creation, listening and performer judgement while reducing specific scheduling and notation operations.
reach: Help production teams use explicit rehearsal constraints and deliver reviewed score packages.
role.ambitious_version: A director and composer supported by reliable schedules and score handling, with artistic choices grounded in the actual ensemble.
